items.t: Connected for Safety: How State and Local Agencies Across the Country Are Modernizing Public Safety with Axon
items.sum: Axon (Nasdaq: AXON), the global public safety technology leader, today announced new state and local public safety deployments and expansions nationwide, as agencies upgrade operations with less-lethal weapons, cameras, drones, real-time operations solutions, and AI tools.

items.t: Siyata PTT Joins Axon Arc as Inaugural Partner
items.sum: MONTREAL, November 19, 2026--Siyata PTT, a leading provider of mission-critical Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC) handsets and accessories, today announced that it has joined Axon Arc, Axon’s new partner program. Axon introduced the program on November 16 at the World Police Summit in Dubai.
